mapper.select: SELECT type_id AS typeId, target_category AS targetCategory, target_id AS targetId, extend::text AS extendJson FROM public.type_relations WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY target_category, target_id, type_id

SELECT type_id AS typeId, target_category AS targetCategory, target_id AS targetId, extend::text AS extendJson, deleted AS deleted FROM public.type_relations WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY type_id, target_category, target_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.type_relations (game_id, type_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, target_category, target_id, extend, deleted, updated_at) VALUES ( #{gameId}, #{typeId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{targetCategory}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), #{deleted}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (game_id, type_id, target_category, target_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, deleted = EXCLUDED.deleted, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.type_relations_log (game_id, type_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, target_category, target_id, extend, deleted) VALUES ( #{gameId}, #{typeId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{targetCategory}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), #{deleted} ) ON CONFLICT (game_id, type_id, target_category, target_id, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, deleted = EXCLUDED.deleted
